༄༅/ /dam tshig gi rim pa rnam grol rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam tshig gi rim pa rnam grol rgya mtsho

bzhugs so/ / gdod nas rnam dag 'da' nyams med pa yi/ /chos nyid dam tshig ye bsrungs chen po la/ /gus pas btud de dam tshig rim pa ni/ /rnam grol rgya mtsho bdag gis bri bar bya/ /de la rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i bsrung mtshams las 'das pa'i dam tshig 'da' nyams med pa yin yang*/ lam nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis dam tshig la gnas dgos pas/ rang gi rgyud dag par bya ste/ rgyud chen po rnams las/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig gsum dang*/ yan lag gi dam tshig shes par bya ba/ mi spang ba/ dang du blang ba/ spyad par bya ba/ bsgrub par bya ba rnams la lnga lnga ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsungs kyang*/ yan lag gi dam tshig rnams rtsa ba bsrung ba'i grogs tsam du bstan la/ blang dor rtsol sgrub dang bcas pa'i phyir/ 'dir rtsa bar 'du bas bye brag so sor ma bshad pa'i phyir rtsa ba'i dam tshig rab tu dbye ba brjod par bya'o/ / de la gsum ste/ bsrung bya dam tshig gi dbye ba/ ji ltar bsrung ba'i thabs/ thabs des 'grub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod las/ 'gro ba'i smin so gsum dag las/ /sngags kyi dam tshig gsum du bshad/ /sku dang gsung dang thugags dag las/ /re re la yang dgu dgu ste/ /nyi shu bdun du rnam par dbye/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs las gyes pa'i dam tshig nyi shu rtsa bdun na ི / dang po sku yi dam tshig la phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi/ phyi la'ang gsum du dbye ba'i phyi'i phyi ni/ ma byin pa len pa/ phyi'i nang mi tshangs par spyod pa/ phyi'i gsang ba srog gcod pa rnams bsrung ba'o/ sku'i gsang ba'i phyi ni/ rdo rje spun sring gi lus la brdeg par gzas pa'am/ rgyan la smod pa/ nang gi rdo rje mched lcam la dngos su brdeg pa dang*/ bla ma'i yum la gtses pa/ grogs kyi yum la spyad pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsang ba ni bla ma'i grib ma la 'gong ba dang*/ spyan sngar ma gus pa dang*/ bag med pa'i spyod pa rkang lag brkyang nas 'dug pa dang*/

bab col du smra rgod dang*/ sgeg chos kyi mdzes sgeg rnams mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi dam tshig la'ang*/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum las/ phyi'i phyi rdzun du smra ba/ phyi'i nang phra ma/ phyi'i gsang ba gzhan gyi zhe gcod pa rnams las sems bsrung ba'o/ /nang gi phyi chos kyi tshig smra ba/ nang gi nang don yid la sems pa/ nang gi gsang ba gnas lugs rnal 'byor du byed pa rnams la gshe skur mi 'debs pa'o/ /gsung gi gsang ba'i phyi/ rdo rje spun sring gi tshig nang bla ma'i phyag rgya dang nye 'khor gyi tshig gsang ba bla ma'i gsung rnams la mi brnyas shing ji skad gsungs pa mi bcag par bsgrub pa'o/ /gsum pa thugs kyi dam tshig la'ang phyi nang gsang ba gsum las/ phyi'i phyi spyir gzhan gyi nor dang*/ bye brag tu bla ma'i dkor la brnab sems byed pa/ phyi'i nang spyir sems can thams cad/ bye brag tu rdo rje mched lcam la gnod sems 'chang ba/ phyi'i gsang ba spyir chos dang gang zag la log lta skyes pa/ bye brag tu rang gi bla ma dang*/ chos la log par lta ba rnams spang bar bya'o/ /thugs kyi nang gi phyi spyod pa log pas bag med dang tho co/ nang gi nang sgom pa log pas bying rgod dang gol sgrib/ nang gi gsang ba lta ba log pas rtag chad dang mthar 'dzin rnams spang par bya'o/ /thugs kyi gsang ba'i phyi/ nyin zhag gi thun la lta sgom spyod pa yid la ma bsgom pa/ gsang ba'i nang*/ yi dam gyi lha yid la mi bsgom pa gsang ba'i gsang ba/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rdo rje mched lcam la brtse gdung yid la mi bsgom par rnams spang la/ brtson zhing gus pa yid la bya'o/ /de ltar dam tshig nyi shu rtsa bdun po rnams legs par bsrung zhing*/ gzhan yang gsang bar 'os pa dang*/ gnyer gtad pa dang*/ gsang ba khas blangs pa rnams kyang mig ltar bsrung dgos te/ dam tshig bkod pa mchog gi sdom pa'i rgyud las/ spyir yang rtsa ba'i dam tshig las/

/ gsang bar 'os dang gnyer gtad dang*/ /gsang bar khas blangs bstan pa dang*/ /smras dang yid kyis log spyad na/ /'di yang mnar med rgyur 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gsang bar 'os pa sngags kyi dam rdzas sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga dang rdo rje dril bu bhandha phur pa la sogs pa dang*/ nang gi lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan ris su bris pa la sogs pa ste/ theg pa dman pa'i blor mi shong pa'i yo byad rnams skal med la bstan na sgro skur 'debs pas sba bar bya'o/ /gnyer tu gtad pa ni/ 'di spongs shig 'di sgrubs shig la sogs pa bla mas bka' stsal pa'i spang blang gi rim pa/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig nas bya ba phran tshegs kyi bar thams cad ji ltar khas blangs pa bzhin bya'o/ / gsang bar khas blang pa ni/ bla ma dang mched lcam gyi nor 'khrul grags su mi rung ba byung ba'am/ sgrub rten gyi las rgya la sogs pa gzhan gyi sgro skur gyi rgyur 'gyur ba rnams gsang zhing rang gis kyang de la brnyas thabs dang log lta mi bya bar dag snang dang mos gus bya'o/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi bla ma ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pas/ de la bkur sti dang sri zhu thams cad kyis mchod cing*/ sangs rgyas las drin che ba'i mos gus rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub chen po 'byung bar nges pa yin no/ /de'i dus su bdud sdig can rnams mi dga' bas rang dang bla ma'i bar du dam tshig gi sel du 'gyur ba sna tshogs la brtson par byed de/ res 'ga' bla ma'i mdzad spyod cho rol zang thal gyis thugs kyi rtsal sbyangs shing*/ gzhan gyi dad pa brtag pa la sogs pa la ma dad pa'i sems su bsgyur ba dang*/ res 'ga' gzhan gyis smad dus bla ma la skyon dang log par lta ba dang*/ res 'ga' don med par nye ring dang phyogs char bzung nas bdag la sdang*/ gzhan la byams sems mi mnyam pa la sogs pa 'byung zhing rdo rje'i mched lcam la chags sdang dang sgro skur gyis sems kyi khong khro bar 'char ro/

/de'i dus su bla ma dang mched lcam gyi yon tan dran zhing snang ba de nyid rang gi blo la bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs par shes na dam tshig rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du/ shel gyi khang bu brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ sngags 'chang rnal 'byor brtson pa na/ /bdud rnams mos pa bsgyur ba yis/ /dam tshig nyes pa rnam par brtsam/ /de bas rab tu shes par bya/ /bla ma'i thugs ni skad cig kyang*/ / dkrugs par bya ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin rdo rje spun sring la/ /smod cing rtsub pa'i 'du shes spongs/ /zhes so/ / don gnyis pa ji ltar bsrung ba'i thabs la bzhi ste/ ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul/ bsrungs pa'i phan yon/ ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs/ nyams na gso thabs so/ /dang po ni dran pa shes bzhin bag yod gsum gyis bsrung ste/ dam tshig gi spang bya mngon du gyur dus gnyen po dran pa dang*/ nyams pa'i nyes pa dang*/ bsrung ba'i phan yon shes bzhin dang*/ sgo gsum bag yod dang ldan pas bag ma khyo khyim du zhugs pa ltar/ dus rtag tu bca' khrims kyis mi dge ba'i phyogs las sems bsrung dgos te/ de nyid las/ des na sngags pas 'bad par yang*/ /shes bzhin gyis ni zin par bya/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni tshe 'dir yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub cing*/ phyi mar sangs rgyas thob pa ste/ de nyid las/ dam tshig mchog dang ldan gyur na/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel/ /mkha' 'gros stong grogs byed pa dang*/ / grub pa brgyad rnams dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /thar pa'i bdag po mchog la reg /ces so/ / gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo rin po che rnam par brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ sku yi dam tshig las 'das na sangs rgyas sku zhes tshig dang bral/ /'di ltar khams gsum sems can rnams/ /srog ni dus gcig bcad pa bas/ /phas pham pa ni sdig mtha' yas/ /de bzhin gsung gi zhig pa na/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi tshig mi gnas/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/

/lce yi dbang po dus gcig la/ /bcad pa'i sdig pas 'di mtha' yas/ /gal te thugs nyams gyur pa na/ khams gsum gang ba'i bsam gtan pa'i/ /don la gnas pa'i dge slong rnams/ /dus gcig sems dkrugs sems sun phyung*/ /sdig pa 'di ni pha mtha' yas/ /zhes pa dang*/ gsang snying las/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /sgrub pa thams cad log pa dang*/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs pa'i/ /'bras bu mi 'dod bzhin du 'du/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ dug nad can dug sos pa bzhin du sngon byas 'gyod/ phyin chad mi byed/ da lta sdom blo dang ldan pas bla ma dang rdo rje spun sring gi nyes pa ni/ de dag yod na mdun du tshogs dang yo byad kyis mnyes par byas la bshags/ med na sku gzugs la sogs pa'i mdun du bshags shing yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa dang*/ skong bshags bya ba dang*/ tshogs brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pas sor chud pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar bshags so/ /rtags ni rmi lam du bla ma dang mkha' 'gros legs so byin pa dang*/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rmi lam du gos dkar po gyon pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ me tog gi tshal na 'dug pa la sogs pa'o/ /de yang zhag gis bar ma chod pa'i nyes pa ni dam las 'gal ba ste/ de ma thag tu bshags pas 'dag go /zla bas bar ma chod pa ni nyams pa ste/ skong bshags la sogs pa lan bdun gyis bar du bshags pas 'dag go /los ma chod pa ni 'das pa ste/ tshogs dang bu dang bdog pa thams cad kyis bskangs na sos so/ /lo gsum tshun chad ni ral ba ste/ srog gis bskangs na sos so/ /de phan chad gsor mi rung ste/ rdo rje nyi ma las/ spyir ni dam tshig khyad par las/ /dus las khyad par des phye ba/ / dam las 'gal zhes nyes byas gang*/ /zhag gis bar ma chod pa ni/ / dmigs pa'i yul la bshags byas na/ /des ni sor yang chud pa'o/ /nyams zhes zla bas ma chod par/ /'gyod pa drag pos bshags pas sos/ /dam las 'das na lo dag gis/

/bar du ma chod bshags pas sos/ /lo ni gnyis dang gsum dag la/ /dam tshig ral ba zhes bya ba/ /mchog tu drag na gso ru rung*/ /lo gsum dag las 'das pa ni/ /nam yang gso bar mi rung ste/ /gal te blangs na gnyis ka 'tshig /nges par sa spyod sdug bsngal las/ /rgyun du spyod pa kho na'o/ /'gal na tshogs kyi 'khor los bshags/ / nyams na rang gis bdog pas bskang*/ /'das na bu dang chung ma dang*/ /nye 'khor lus dang ngag dag dang*/ /yid dang bdog par bcas pas bskang*/ / ral pa rang gi srog gis bskang*/ /zhes so/ /de yang dam tshig gi nyes pa rmi lam du byung yang sad ma thag ma bshags na ngan song du skye na/ dngos su byung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos pas gso ba'i thabs la brtson dgos te/ bkod pa chen po las/ bla ma dang ni nye ba'i 'khor/ /de bzhin rdo rje spun sring la/ /ngan smras tshig gi zur tsam yang*/ /brda'am dngos por brjod mi bya/ /gal te rmi lam dag tu yang*/ /byung na yid kyis bshags par bya/ /dngos dang yid kyis byas pa dang*/ /gal te dran pas ma zin par/ /thal bar gyur kyang ma bshags na/ /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes so/ /de'ang sku'i nyams na rang gi lus kyi chos spyod phyag dang bskor ba mchod bstod la sogs pas bshags so/ / gsung gi nyams na sngags dang kha ton gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa gsung rab klog pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /thugs kyi nyams na sgom sgrub lta ba ting nge 'dzin mos gus dag snang bya ba la sogs pas bshags so/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba dam tshig skyon med pa yin la/ ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba yang dam tshig gtsang ba las 'byung gi nyams na de yi grib kyis mi 'du zhing*/ gang yang mi 'grub pa'i dam tshig skyon med kho na la 'bad par bya ba ni gsang sngags kyi khyad chos yin no/ /don gsum pa thabs des 'grub pa'i 'bras bu la gnyis las/ thun mong gi dngos grub 'phrin las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa ste/

nad gdon sdig sgrib la sogs pa zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang dpal 'byor 'khor 'das rgyas pa la sogs pa dang*/ mi nor mkha' 'gro 'du ba la sogs pa dang*/ dgra bgegs bsad rengs 'grub pa la sogs pa yid la bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub cing*/ nyams dang rtogs pa gong 'phel du 'char te/ snga ma las/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po 'grub/ /phrin las bzhi po thogs med cing*/ /rtogs pa mchog ni gong du 'phel/ /zhes so/ /mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med par 'gyur te/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ rtsa ba gsum las nges dbye ba/ /dgu yis rnam par phye ba las/ /nyi shu bdun gyi dbye ba yis/ /sngags las khyad par nang pa yi/ /dam tshig rnam par bsdus te phye/ /'di las 'gal bar ma byas na/ /rdo rje 'dzin par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par nges/ /zhes so/ /de dag kyang bsdu na/ sems la dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsgrub cing*/ mi dge ba cha dang bcas pa sdom pas skyon med par byed pa ste/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ spyir na dam tshig zhes bya ba/ rang sems tshig pa med pa la/ / g.yo sgyu rnams dang bral ba'o/ /zhes so/ /de yi 'bras bu yang dngos grub thob pa ste/ rdo rje snying po sra ba 'byung gnas kyi rgyud las/ /dam tshig sdom pa rnam bshad pa/ /kun kyang rang gi sems las so/ /de yi 'phan pa bla mas shes/ /de phyir sems la 'dris pa'i mis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /sku gsum tshad du 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mngon par 'grub/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ /de yi byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang*/ /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur/ /grogs la brtse gdung ldan pa'i mis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'du ba dang*/ /kun gyis snyan par grags pa dang*/

/gzugs can kun kyang byams pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba dang*/ /ma bsgrubs dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*/ /de bzhin mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgon par gnas pa'i mis/ /rlung sems tshad rnams zin pa dang*/ /snang ba grogs su 'char ba dang*/ /rang gi sems la dbang thob 'gyur/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mis/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ /'khor 'das rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu dbang rdzogs byas pa'i mi/ /'gro ba'i gtso bor 'gyur ba dang*/ /kun gyis mthong na dga' ba dang*/ /ye shes mngon du 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlab 'gyur/ /rtag tu gtor ma'i las byed la/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ /bar chad med cing las rnams 'grub/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro bran bzhin 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /rdo rje theg la rab zhugasate/ /dam tshig sdom pa rnam dag cing*/ /byang chub dam pa thob par shog /gsang ba snying thig gi man ngag mchog tu gsang ba las/ dam tshig gi rim pa rnam grol rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)dam tshig gi rim pa rnam grol rgya mtsho/ - PAGE 164 -- PAGE 163 - - PAGE 155 -
